history.sg_progress: The Administration will endeavour to ensure that core functions are performed by regular staff members and that contracted personnel will be used to perform assignments only when there is no expertise in the Organization. In the case of the Office of Information and Communications Technology, it is working with the Office of the Controller to produce its operational plan, which will contain a comprehensive assessment of the related resource requirements. As part of the review, the Office of Information and Communications Technology will determine, on the basis of highly specific needs, whether some recurrent functions performed by personnel currently engaged through contractual services ought to be transitioned to its core staffing complement.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that contracted personnel are performing assignments only when there is no expertise in the Organization and that core functions are performed by regular staff members.
history.administration_response: A review of the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) contracted workforce has been finalized, which resulted in a new project engagement with UNOPS as from 1 January 2024, supported by two financial agreements that adhere to the 2014 United Nations UNOPS umbrella memorandum of understanding. The consultants are performing highly specialized tasks related to custom web application development, infrastructure maintenance and data analysis. No capacity exists in the Organization to perform this function. The Development Coordination Office proposes closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that no capacity exists in the Organization to perform this function, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
